name: VaultFront
concept: The vault entrance of the 1989 Everon bank: door concept 1 (round, grey wheel) in its frame, collar and a section of reinforced wall. The door is a separate part on a hinge bone so it can swing open.
prompt: 1989 bank vault entrance: a round grey-green steel vault door with a four-spoke wheel, set in a heavy round frame and collar in a square block of reinforced wall. no text, no logos.
build: meshy-6 image-to-3D for the door, frame ring and hinge barrels; wall block, tunnel and collar in Blender; LOD0 kept dense
